title: Explore the ideology of deep learning in ENSO forecasts
summary: The study analyzes a deep-learning ENSO forecaster using bounded-variation methods and tests regional predictor contributions and spring-barrier forecast behavior. The result is reported in the Geoscience Letters. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
